Video und Audio werden über ihre RTP-Zei: Video and audio are aligned to each other by their RTP timestamps (the sender’s common clock) and played out by the Mac’s clock. In lip sync as long as the sender stamps both streams from the same clock.
Video and audio are referenced to capture time by their RTP timestamps and played out by the network’s PTP clock. The Mac takes part in PTP only passively (slave).

Weil die Essenzen getrennt sind, lassen: Because the essences are separate, picture and sound can be routed independently. The receiver has to bring them back together.
Wie gleichmäßig der Sender seine Pakete: How evenly the sender spreads its packets. Narrow: very even, suitable for all receivers. Wide: more bursts, only for receivers with a larger buffer.
Wie viele Pakete sich im Modell-Netzpuff: How many packets back up in the model network buffer, per frame (ST 2110-21). Below the “Narrow” line the sender is as even as sensitive receivers expect.
Wird bei manueller Eingabe und beim Setz: Checked for manual entry and when setting destination addresses via IS-05.
Wirkt auf das Gerät und damit auf alle E: Affects the device and therefore every receiver.
Zeilensprungformat wird nicht unterstütz: Interlaced formats are not supported. Set a progressive format on the SDI source device.
Zeit von der Aufnahme beim Sender bis zu: Time from capture at the sender to arrival at the Mac, from the RTP timestamps.

• Falsche Netzwerkschnittstelle gewählt\:

• Sender not active or using a different multicast address than in the SDP
• macOS firewall blocks incoming data for this app
• Local Network access not allowed for this app (System Settings › Privacy & Security)
• Sender neu gestartet oder umkonfigurie:
• Sender restarted or reconfigured
• No SDI signal at the Blackmagic device
• Cable or adapter disconnected
• Multicast membership expired on the switch (no IGMP querier)
